description: Get a list of all categories associated with the user's account. Categories are sorted by their order; categories without an order are listed alphabetically after those that have one.

format.description: If `flattened`, returns the same top-level categories as `nested`, plus grouped categories also appear at the top level alongside their category groups. If `nested`, returns top-level categories (either category groups or categories not part of a category group) in an array, with grouped categories nested within their category group under the property children. Ignored when is_group is set. Defaults to nested.

is_group.description: If true, returns only category groups. If false, returns only categories that are not part of a category group (grouped categories are excluded). When set, format is ignored.

name: get_all_categories
